457: The leader of Lagoon Company and captain of the ex-American Navy PT boat Black Lagoon. He is a former American soldier who fought in the Vietnam War. He tends to stay away from the fighting associated with Lagoon Company's activities.
458: Revy, sometimes referred by her full name Rebecca Lee, is the female protagonist of the series. She does most of the fighting for the Lagoon Company. Very little is revealed about her past, although portions can be pieced together through the series.
459: Rock, formerly known as Rokuro Okajima, is the protagonist of the series. He was a Japanese salaryman for Asahi Industries in Tokyo until he was taken hostage by the crew of the Black Lagoon.
460: Benny is a college dropout from a Florida university where he studied until getting into trouble with the FBI and the mafia. He works as the Lagoon Company's mechanic, computer specialist, and researcher.
461: Balalaika is the boss of Hotel Moscow. It is revealed in the novel that her real name is Sofiya Pavlovena, though this name is never used in her presence. She is sometimes referred as Vladilena reduction from Vladimir Ilich Lenin.
462: Eda is a nun in a convent in Roanapur with ties to the underground (since the convent is mainly a smuggling operation). She is friends with Revy but that doesn't keep them from pointing their guns at each other in business matters as they share the same hotheaded personality.
2762: Roberta is a maid who worked for four years at the Lovelace household in Venezuela. Although her domestic skills, such as cleaning and cooking, were poor, she has developed a close friendship with the young scion of the Lovelace family, Garcia.
3450: Wai-San Chang (also known as Mr. Chang) is the boss of a branch of the Triads based in Thailand. Like Revy, he is adept with wielding a pistol in each hand (Beretta 76 and AMT Hardballer) in a fashion similar to that of gun fu.
4988: Lotton "The Wizard" is a mysterious looking man and one of the bounty hunters hired to catch "Greenback" Jane. He has gray hair, wears a black trench coat and shaded glasses, and speaks in a light voice.
6373: Hänsel and Gretel are two unnamed Romanian identical twin orphans, suggested to be male and female, who were abandoned in a state-run orphanage due to the Nicolae Ceauşescu regime's ban on abortion.
6479: Frederica Sawyer is a cleaner in the town of Roanapur, Thailand, who specializes in body disposal, but occasionally delves into bounty hunter work. She uses a chainsaw as her disposal tool as well as weapon during bounty hunter work.
9007: Shenhua is a Taiwanese assassin in the employ of Mr. Chang. She prefers to use various edged weapons in close combat, in particular a pair of kukri knives linked together with a length of leather rope at the handles. She is also skilled in the use of throwing knives.
14238: Garcia Fernando Lovelace is the only son of Diego Jose San Fernando Lovelace. He was heir to the Lovelace family line, and as such, is its current head, the twelfth in succession after his father was assassinated.
14385: Ginji Matsuzaki is the acting wakagashira (underboss) of Washimine Group. He is currently working as a street stall vendor, but was formerly an assassin nicknamed "Hitokiri Ginji" (Manslayer Ginji) due to his use of a katana in combat.
15755: Luak was a pirate captain who was based in Roanapur and often raided the coast and rivers of nearby Thailand. Although he was good, he had the bad habit of attracting unwanted company (Chin once commented that a warship had once pursued him).
18956: Chin is a Chinese crime boss who made several serious attempts to replace Balalaika as one of the major powers of Roanapur.
20263: Janet Bhai, also known as Greenback Jane, is a professional money counterfeiter from India. She served as the leader for her project team, which was spread around the world but was connected thanks to the internet, and is quite knowledgeable on the details of the dollar bill.
20264: Leigharch is an Irish driver who worked with Shenhua at one time. A compulsive smoker of marijuana (in the manga he actually snorts cocaine), he has a distressingly frequent tendency to hallucinate at inopportune times, such as in the middle of a car chase.
22186: Sister Yolanda is the leader of the Church of Violence, often called "the Rip-off Church" by much of Roanapur.
22187: The African-American owner of the Roanapur strip club 'GoofFest', Rowan "Jackpot" Pigeon also operates in the trafficking of child pornography and "snuff" films within Southeast Asia.
22188: Wentzel Ahbe was a highly-decorated U-Boat captain in the Kriegsmarine, who had survived many a depth-charge battle during the Battle of the Atlantic. In March of 1945, he led U-1324 out of Kiel, Germany on one last mission: transport Lt. Col.
22311: Born in the Adachi ward in Tokyo, Masahiro Takenaka spent much of his life fighting one revolution after another. Originally part of the Japanese Red Army, he had to leave the country after many of his compatriots had been arrested.
22516: Verrocchio is a minor mob boss, representing the Italian mob on Roanapur. Once one of the major operators on the island, his power and reputation had been supplanted when Hotel Moscow and Balalaika had moved in, taking all his drug trafficking routes.
22517: Lt. Col. Matsuda was an officer of the Imperial Japanese Army who was posted in Germany, mainly to learn aeronautics from the German Luftwaffe. In March of 1945, he returned home onboard U-1324, commanded by Capt. Wentzel Ahbe. One other passenger, SS Lt. Col.
23188: Abrego is the head of the Manisarela Cartel's branch in Roanapur. His brash, cowardly activities on the island, which often ended in bloodshed, was a source of disgust from other mob leaders like Balalaika and Mr. Chang.
25548: Ratchman is the leader of the Aryan Socialist Union, a neo-Nazi organization operating in the United States.
25549: Fritz Stanford is a member of the Aryan Socialist Union, a United States-based neo-Nazi group that accompanied their leader Ratchman on a salvage operation not far from Jakarta (originally named Batavia).
25550: Originally a Waffen SS officer in Nazi Germany, Alfred was part of a cabal of officers within the SS who had realized that the days of the Third Reich was at an end.
25551: Captain, as he's known by his fellows, is a mercenary under contract with the Extra Order Company, a private security firm that was contracted by Kageyama of Asahi Heavy Industries.
29458: Fabiola is a young maid in the employ of the Lovelace family. She is one of the maids who work as Roberta's subordinates, and the only other combat-trained person among the maids apart from Roberta herself.
29659: "Groovy Guy" Russel is a middle-aged American man who works for the Florida crime syndicate that's tracking Jane. He is quite distinguishable, since he dresses like a cowboy: he has the trademark hat, boots with spurs, a revolver at the hip, bandoleer belt, tan shirt and jeans.
29660: Claude "Torch" Weaver s a heavyset, middle-aged man with blonde hair and glasses and always sports a grin with a look of a stereotypical everyman.
29904: Hänsel and Gretel are two unnamed Romanian identical twin orphans, suggested to be male and female, who were abandoned in a state-run orphanage due to the Nicolae Ceauşescu regime's ban on abortion.
31841: Shane Caxton is an American black-ops operator who is currently in Roanapur, awaiting deployment into Indochina. Like Dutch, Caxton is a Vietnam War veteran who still holds on to his moral code of conduct.
47291: Kageyama is one of the department chiefs of Asahi Industries, based in Tokyo. He was entrusted by its board of directors to ensure that their illegal activities were not exposed.
50383: Maki is a female high school junior and goes to the same high school as her friend, Yukio Washimine.
58147: Boris is Balalaika's second-in-command. He can be easily identified by the large scar running from the right side of his forehead to his left cheek. He is a calm, broad-built man with a deep Russian accent. Like Balalaika, he also saw service in Afghanistan.
70075: Sakharov was teamed with Menshov, and is an ex-Russian soldier.
143991: Ronnie "The Jaws" is Verrocchio's replacement in Roanapur. Just as diplomatic as Verrocchio, his group does have a reputation for being vicious, almost as much as Hotel Moscow.
159107: One of the leaders of the Protectors of the Islamic Front. Appeared in episode 11 of the anime
274270: Member of the Cuban special forces that were sent to hunt down Roberta
274271: Member of Grey Fox. Leader of Echo squad
274272: Father of Garcia Lovelace and the former head of the Lovelace family
